<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <title>NYC Bodega Virtual Environment</title>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.4.0/p5.js"></script>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<script>
let cameraX = 0;
let cameraY = -30;
let cameraZ = 250;
let lookX = 0;
let lookZ = -1;
let rotationY = 0;
const moveSpeed = 5;

// Textures
let floorPattern;
let wallPattern;
let shelfPattern;
let counterPattern;

function setup() {
  createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGL);
  perspective(PI/3.0, width/height, 0.1, 500);
  
  // Create procedural textures
  floorPattern = createFloorTexture();
  wallPattern = createWallTexture();
  shelfPattern = createShelfTexture();
  counterPattern = createCounterTexture();
}

function createFloorTexture() {
  let g = createGraphics(100, 100);
  g.background(180);
  for(let i = 0; i < 100; i += 20) {
    for(let j = 0; j < 100; j += 20) {
      g.noStroke();
      g.fill(160 + random(-20, 20));
      g.rect(i, j, 20, 20);
    }
  }
  return g;
}

function createWallTexture() {
  let g = createGraphics(100, 100);
  g.background(220);
  for(let i = 0; i < 100; i += 10) {
    g.stroke(200);
    g.line(i, 0, i, 100);
  }
  return g;
}

function createShelfTexture() {
  let g = createGraphics(100, 100);
  g.background(139, 69, 19);
  for(let i = 0; i < 100; i += 5) {
    g.stroke(120, 60, 15);
    g.line(0, i, 100, i);
  }
  return g;
}

function createCounterTexture() {
  let g = createGraphics(100, 100);
  g.background(150);
  for(let i = 0; i < 100; i += 10) {
    for(let j = 0; j < 100; j += 10) {
      g.stroke(140);
      g.noFill();
      g.rect(i, j, 10, 10);
    }
  }
  return g;
}

function draw() {
  background(50);
  
  // Camera position and orientation
  camera(cameraX, cameraY, cameraZ, 
         cameraX + lookX, cameraY, cameraZ + lookZ, 
         0, 1, 0);
  
  // Lighting
  pointLight(255, 255, 255, 0, -100, 0);
  pointLight(255, 255, 200, -100, -50, -150); // Deli counter light
  ambientLight(100);
  
  // Floor
  push();
  translate(0, 50, 0);
  rotateX(HALF_PI);
  texture(floorPattern);
  plane(300, 400);
  pop();
  
  // Walls
  push();
  texture(wallPattern);
  // Left wall
  push();
  translate(-150, 0, 0);
  rotateY(HALF_PI);
  plane(400, 200);
  pop();
  
  // Right wall
  push();
  translate(150, 0, 0);
  rotateY(HALF_PI);
  plane(400, 200);
  pop();
  
  // Back wall
  push();
  translate(0, 0, -200);
  plane(300, 200);
  pop();
  pop();
  
  // Two parallel aisles
  for(let x = -50; x <= 50; x += 100) {
    for(let z = -150; z < 0; z += 30) {
      drawShelf(x, z);
    }
  }
  
  // Counter with deli grill
  push();
  translate(-100, 20, -170);
  texture(counterPattern);
  box(80, 60, 40);
  
  // Grill top
  push();
  translate(0, -30, 0);
  fill(80);
  box(70, 2, 35);
  // Grill details
  for(let x = -30; x < 30; x += 10) {
    for(let z = -15; z < 15; z += 10) {
      push();
      translate(x, 0, z);
      fill(60);
      box(8, 1, 8);
      pop();
    }
  }
  pop();
  pop();
}

function drawShelf(x, z) {
  push();
  translate(x, 0, z);
  
  // Shelf structure
  texture(shelfPattern);
  box(50, 100, 20);
  
  // Stack stick figures on shelves
  for(let y = -30; y <= 30; y += 15) {
    for(let zOffset = -8; zOffset <= 8; zOffset += 8) {
      drawStickFigure(0, y, zOffset);
    }
  }
  pop();
}

function drawStickFigure(x, y, z) {
  push();
  translate(x, y, z);
  scale(2);
  
  // Head
  fill(255, 220, 180);
  sphere(1);
  
  // Body
  stroke(random(150, 255), random(150, 255), random(150, 255));
  strokeWeight(0.5);
  line(0, 1, 0, 0, 4, 0);
  
  // Arms
  line(-2, 2, 0, 2, 2, 0);
  
  // Legs
  line(0, 4, 0, -1, 6, 0);
  line(0, 4, 0, 1, 6, 0);
  pop();
}

function keyPressed() {
  const lookSpeed = 0.1;
  
  if (keyCode === 65) { // A key - strafe left
    cameraX -= moveSpeed * cos(rotationY);
    cameraZ -= moveSpeed * sin(rotationY);
  }
  if (keyCode === 68) { // D key - strafe right
    cameraX += moveSpeed * cos(rotationY);
    cameraZ += moveSpeed * sin(rotationY);
  }
  if (keyCode === 87) { // W key - move forward
    cameraX += moveSpeed * sin(rotationY);
    cameraZ -= moveSpeed * cos(rotationY);
  }
  if (keyCode === 83) { // S key - move backward
    cameraX -= moveSpeed * sin(rotationY);
    cameraZ += moveSpeed * cos(rotationY);
  }
  if (keyCode === LEFT_ARROW) {
    rotationY -= lookSpeed;
    lookX = sin(rotationY);
    lookZ = -cos(rotationY);
  }
  if (keyCode === RIGHT_ARROW) {
    rotationY += lookSpeed;
    lookX = sin(rotationY);
    lookZ = -cos(rotationY);
  }
}

function windowResized() {
  resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.4.0/p5.js"></script>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #000; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <script>
    let noiseScale = 0.02;
    let timeScale = 0.0005;
    let resolution = 100;
    let terrain = [];
    let rotationX = Math.PI/3;
    let rotationY = 0;
    let contourLevels = 20;
    let hueOffset = 0;

    function setup() {
      createCanvas(800, 800, WEBGL);
      colorMode(HSB, 360, 100, 100, 1);
      
      // Initialize terrain grid
      for (let x = 0; x < resolution; x++) {
        terrain[x] = [];
        for (let y = 0; y < resolution; y++) {
          // terrain[x][y] = 0;
        }
      }
    }

    function updateTerrain() {
      for (let x = 0; x < resolution; x++) {
        for (let y = 0; y < resolution; y++) {
          let noiseVal = 0;
          // Layer multiple noise frequencies
          for (let octave = 0; octave < 2; octave++) {
            let freq = pow(2, octave);
            noiseVal += (1 / freq) * noise(
              x * noiseScale * freq,
              y * noiseScale * freq,
              frameCount * timeScale * freq
            );
          }
          terrain[x][y] = noiseVal * 100;
        }
      }
    }

    function draw() {
      background(230, 10, 15, 0.01);
      
      // Update terrain heights
      updateTerrain();
      
      // Set up camera and rotation
      // rotateX(rotationX);
      // rotateY(rotationY + frameCount * 0.002);
      translate(-width/2, -height/2);
      
      // Draw contour lines
      for (let level = 0; level < contourLevels; level++) {
        let heightThreshold = map(level, 0, contourLevels, -100, 300);
        let levelHue = (hueOffset + map(level, 0, contourLevels, 0, 60)) % 360;
        
        stroke(260+level, 70, 85, 0.1);
        noFill();
        
        // Draw horizontal contours
        for (let y = 0; y < resolution - 1; y++) {
          beginShape(LINES);
          for (let x = 0; x < resolution - 1; x++) {
            let currentHeight = terrain[x][y];
            let nextHeight = terrain[x + 1][y];
            
            if ((currentHeight <= heightThreshold && nextHeight >= heightThreshold) ||
                (currentHeight >= heightThreshold && nextHeight <= heightThreshold)) {
              let inter = map(heightThreshold, currentHeight, nextHeight, 0, 1);
              let xPos = map(x + inter, 0, resolution - 1, 0, width);
              let yPos = map(y, 0, resolution - 1, 0, height);
              vertex(xPos, yPos, heightThreshold);
            }
          }
          endShape();
        }
        
        // Draw vertical contours
        for (let x = 0; x < resolution - 1; x++) {
          beginShape(LINES);
          for (let y = 0; y < resolution - 1; y++) {
            let currentHeight = terrain[x][y];
            let nextHeight = terrain[x][y + 1];
            
            if ((currentHeight <= heightThreshold && nextHeight >= heightThreshold) ||
                (currentHeight >= heightThreshold && nextHeight <= heightThreshold)) {
              let inter = map(heightThreshold, currentHeight, nextHeight, 0, 1);
              let xPos = map(x, 0, resolution - 1, 0, width);
              let yPos = map(y + inter, 0, resolution - 1, 0, height);
              vertex(xPos, yPos, heightThreshold);
            }
          }
          endShape();
        }
      }
      
      // Update hue offset for color cycling
      hueOffset = (hueOffset + 0.2) % 360;
    }

    function mouseDragged() {
      // Adjust rotation based on mouse movement
      rotationY += (mouseX - pmouseX) * 0.01;
      rotationX = constrain(
        rotationX + (mouseY - pmouseY) * 0.01,
        0,
        PI/2
      );
      return false;
    }

    function mouseWheel(event) {
      // Adjust noise scale with mouse wheel
      noiseScale = constrain(
        noiseScale + event.delta * 0.0001,
        0.01,
        0.05
      );
      return false;
    }
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Genuary - Mirrored Grid Design</title>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.4.0/p5.js"></script>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<script>
let cells = 10; // number of cells per row
let shapes = [];
let maxSize;

class GridShape {
    constructor(x, y, cellSize) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.cellSize = cellSize;
        this.size = this.cellSize;
        this.targetSize = random(this.cellSize * 0.2, this.cellSize);
        this.hue = random(360);
        this.speed = random(0.02, 0.05);
        this.phase = random(TWO_PI);
    }

    update() {
        this.size = lerp(this.size, this.targetSize, 0.1);
        if (abs(this.size - this.targetSize) < 0.5) {
            this.targetSize = random(this.cellSize * 0.2, this.cellSize);
        }
    }

    display(mirror = false) {
        push();
        colorMode(HSB, 360, 100, 100);
        let h = (this.hue + frameCount * 0.5) % 360;
        fill(h, 80, 90);
        noStroke();
        
        let xPos = this.x;
        if (mirror) {
            xPos = width - this.x - this.cellSize;
        }
        
        translate(xPos + this.cellSize/2, this.y + this.cellSize/2);
        let wobble = sin(frameCount * this.speed + this.phase) * 3;
        rectMode(CENTER);
        rect(0, 0, this.size + wobble, this.size + wobble);
        pop();
    }
}

function createGrid() {
    shapes = [];
    let cellSize = width / (cells ); // divide by 2 to account for mirrored side
    maxSize = cellSize;
    
    for (let x = 0; x < cells; x++) {
        for (let y = 0; y < cells; y++) {
            shapes.push(new GridShape(
                x * cellSize,
                y * cellSize,
                cellSize
            ));
        }
    }
}

function setup() {
    createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
    createGrid();
}

function draw() {
    background(20);
    
    // Update and draw original grid
    for (let shape of shapes) {
        shape.update();
        shape.display(false);  // Original
        shape.display(true);   // Mirrored
    }
}

function windowResized() {
    resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
    createGrid();
}

function keyPressed() {
    // Press up/down arrows to change grid size
    if (keyCode === UP_ARROW && cells < 20) {
        cells++;
        createGrid();
    } else if (keyCode === DOWN_ARROW && cells > 2) {
        cells--;
        createGrid();
    }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

files.name: america.txt
files.content:
O beautiful for spacious skies,
For amber waves of grain,
For purple mountain majesties
Above the fruited plain!
America! America!
God shed His grace on thee
And crown thy good with brotherhood
From sea to shining sea!

O beautiful for pilgrim feet,
Whose stern, impassioned stress
A thoroughfare for freedom beat
Across the wilderness!
America! America!
God mend thine every flaw,
Confirm thy soul in self-control,
Thy liberty in law!

O beautiful for heroes proved
In liberating strife,
Who more than self their country loved
And mercy more than life!
America! America!
May God thy gold refine,
Till all success be nobleness,
And every gain divine!

O beautiful for patriot dream
That sees beyond the years
Thine alabaster cities gleam
Undimmed by human tears!
America! America!
God shed His grace on thee
And crown thy good with brotherhood
From sea to shining sea!

files.name: spangled.txt
files.content:
Oh, say can you see by the dawn's early light
What so proudly we hailed at the twilight's last gleaming?
Whose broad stripes and bright stars through the perilous fight,
O'er the ramparts we watched were so gallantly streaming?
And the rocket's red glare, the bombs bursting in air,
Gave proof through the night that our flag was still there.
Oh, say does that star-spangled banner yet wave
O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave?
On the shore, dimly seen through the mists of the deep,
Where the foe's haughty host in dread silence reposes,
What is that which the breeze, o'er the towering steep,
As it fitfully blows, half conceals, half discloses?
Now it catches the gleam of the morning's first beam,
In full glory reflected now shines in the stream:
'Tis the star-spangled banner! Oh long may it wave
O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave!
And where is that band who so vauntingly swore
That the havoc of war and the battle's confusion,
A home and a country should leave us no more!
Their blood has washed out their foul footsteps' pollution.
No refuge could save the hireling and slave
From the terror of flight, or the gloom of the grave:
And the star-spangled banner in triumph doth wave
O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave!
Oh! thus be it ever, when freemen shall stand
Between their loved home and the war's desolation!
Blest with victory and peace, may the heav'n rescued land
Praise the Power that hath made and preserved us a nation.
Then conquer we must, when our cause it is just,
And this be our motto: "In God is our trust."
And the star-spangled banner in triumph shall wave
O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave!

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>3D Landscape</title>
    <style>
        canvas {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            display: block;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="glCanvas"></canvas>
    <script>
        let gl;
        let program;
        let positions = [];
        let indices = [];
        
        // Vertex shader
        const vsSource = `
            attribute vec4 aPosition;
            uniform mat4 uModelViewMatrix;
            uniform mat4 uProjectionMatrix;
            varying float vHeight;
            
            void main() {
                vHeight = aPosition.y;
                gl_Position = uProjectionMatrix * uModelViewMatrix * aPosition;
            }
        `;

        // Fragment shader
        const fsSource = `
            precision mediump float;
            varying float vHeight;
            
            void main() {
                vec3 color = mix(vec3(0.1, 0.1, 0.8), vec3(0.8, 0.1, 0.1), vHeight * 0.5);
                gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 1.0);
            }
        `;

        function initGL() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById('glCanvas');
            gl = canvas.getContext('webgl');

            if (!gl) {
                alert('WebGL not available');
                return;
            }

            // Create terrain grid
            const gridSize = 20;
            const scale = 2.0 / gridSize;
            
            for(let z = 0; z < gridSize; z++) {
                for(let x = 0; x < gridSize; x++) {
                    const xPos = (x * scale) - 1.0;
                    const zPos = (z * scale) - 1.0;
                    const yPos = Math.sin(x * 0.5) * Math.cos(z * 0.5) * 0.3;
                    
                    positions.push(xPos, yPos, zPos);
                }
            }

            // Create indices for triangles
            for(let z = 0; z < gridSize-1; z++) {
                for(let x = 0; x < gridSize-1; x++) {
                    const topLeft = z * gridSize + x;
                    const topRight = topLeft + 1;
                    const bottomLeft = (z + 1) * gridSize + x;
                    const bottomRight = bottomLeft + 1;

                    indices.push(topLeft, bottomLeft, topRight);
                    indices.push(topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight);
                }
            }

            // Initialize shaders
            const vertexShader = gl.createShader(gl.VERTEX_SHADER);
            gl.shaderSource(vertexShader, vsSource);
            gl.compileShader(vertexShader);

            const fragmentShader = gl.createShader(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER);
            gl.shaderSource(fragmentShader, fsSource);
            gl.compileShader(fragmentShader);

            program = gl.createProgram();
            gl.attachShader(program, vertexShader);
            gl.attachShader(program, fragmentShader);
            gl.linkProgram(program);
            gl.useProgram(program);

            // Create buffers
            const positionBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
            gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, positionBuffer);
            gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array(positions), gl.STATIC_DRAW);

            const indexBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
            gl.bindBuffer(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, indexBuffer);
            gl.bufferData(gl.ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER, new Uint16Array(indices), gl.STATIC_DRAW);

            const aPosition = gl.getAttribLocation(program, 'aPosition');
            gl.vertexAttribPointer(aPosition, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
            gl.enableVertexAttribArray(aPosition);

            gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);
            
            render();
        }

        function render() {
            gl.clearColor(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
            gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);

            // Set up matrices
            const projectionMatrix = mat4.perspective(mat4.create(), 
                45 * Math.PI / 180,
                gl.canvas.clientWidth / gl.canvas.clientHeight,
                0.1,
                100.0
            );

            const modelViewMatrix = mat4.create();
            mat4.translate(modelViewMatrix, modelViewMatrix, [0.0, 0.0, -4.0]);
            mat4.rotate(modelViewMatrix, modelViewMatrix, Date.now() * 0.001, [0, 1, 0]);

            const uProjectionMatrix = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uProjectionMatrix');
            const uModelViewMatrix = gl.getUniformLocation(program, 'uModelViewMatrix');
            
            gl.uniformMatrix4fv(uProjectionMatrix, false, projectionMatrix);
            gl.uniformMatrix4fv(uModelViewMatrix, false, modelViewMatrix);

            gl.drawElements(gl.TRIANGLES, indices.length, gl.UNSIGNED_SHORT, 0);
            requestAnimationFrame(render);
        }

        // Initialize GL-Matrix library
        function loadGLMatrix() {
            const script = document.createElement('script');
            script.src = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gl-matrix/2.8.1/gl-matrix-min.js';
            script.onload = initGL;
            document.body.appendChild(script);
        }

        window.onload = loadGLMatrix;
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Teachable Machine Outline</title>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.4.0/p5.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tensorflow/tfjs@1.3.1/dist/tf.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@teachablemachine/image@0.8/dist/teachablemachine-image.min.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        // Replace this with your Teachable Machine model URL
        const modelURL = 'YOUR_MODEL_URL_HERE';
        let model, webcam, ctx, labelContainer;

        async function init() {
            const modelURL = "YOUR_MODEL_URL_HERE";
            const model = await tmImage.load(modelURL + "model.json", modelURL + "weights.bin");
            
            // Set up webcam
            webcam = createCapture(VIDEO);
            webcam.size(640, 480);
            webcam.hide();
            
            // Create canvas
            createCanvas(640, 480);
            
            // Start prediction loop
            loop();
        }

        async function draw() {
            // White background
            background(255);
            
            // Predict using the model
            const prediction = await model.predict(webcam.elt);
            
            // Only draw if we detect something with high confidence
            prediction.forEach(pred => {
                if (pred.probability > 0.8) { // Adjust threshold as needed
                    // Get the pixels from the video
                    loadPixels();
                    
                    // Draw simple outline
                    stroke(0);
                    noFill();
                    strokeWeight(2);
                    
                    // Find edges in the image
                    for (let y = 1; y < height-1; y += 2) {
                        for (let x = 1; x < width-1; x += 2) {
                            let index = (x + y * width) * 4;
                            let brightness = (pixels[index] + pixels[index+1] + pixels[index+2]) / 3;
                            
                            // Check neighboring pixels
                            let neighborBrightness = (
                                (pixels[((y-1) * width + x) * 4] +
                                 pixels[((y-1) * width + x) * 4 + 1] +
                                 pixels[((y-1) * width + x) * 4 + 2]) / 3
                            );
                            
                            // If there's a significant difference, draw a point
                            if (Math.abs(brightness - neighborBrightness) > 30) {
                                point(x, y);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // Start everything
        init();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 100vh;
            background: #000;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        function setup() {
            createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
            pixelDensity(1);
            noSmooth();
        }

        function draw() {
            loadPixels();
            
            for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 4) {
                const noiseValue = random(255);
                pixels[i] = noiseValue;     // R
                pixels[i + 1] = noiseValue; // G
                pixels[i + 2] = noiseValue; // B
                pixels[i + 3] = 100;        // A
            }
            
            updatePixels();
          
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.4.0/p5.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/matter-js/0.18.0/matter.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
<script>
let engine;
let world;
let circles = [];
let startPoint = null;
let endPoint = null;
let sliceLine = null;
let originalRadius = 150;

function setup() {
    createCanvas(800, 600);
    
    // Setup Matter.js
    engine = Matter.Engine.create();
    world = engine.world;
    world.gravity.y = 0;  // Disable gravity
    
    // Create initial circle
    circles.push(new LiquidCircle(width/2, height/2, originalRadius));
}

class LiquidCircle {
    constructor(x, y, radius) {
        this.radius = radius;
        this.particles = [];
        this.springs = [];
        this.centerBody = null;
        this.createParticles(x, y);
    }

    createParticles(x, y) {
        const particleCount = 20;
        const angleStep = (2 * PI) / particleCount;
        
        // Create center body
        this.centerBody = Matter.Bodies.circle(x, y, 5, {
            isStatic: false,
            friction: 0.1,
            restitution: 0.5
        });
        Matter.World.add(world, this.centerBody);

        // Create particles around the circle
        for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
            const angle = i * angleStep;
            const px = x + cos(angle) * this.radius;
            const py = y + sin(angle) * this.radius;
            
            const particle = Matter.Bodies.circle(px, py, 10, {
                friction: 0.1,
                restitution: 0.5
            });
            
            this.particles.push(particle);
            Matter.World.add(world, particle);

            // Create spring between particle and center
            const spring = Matter.Constraint.create({
                bodyA: this.centerBody,
                bodyB: particle,
                stiffness: 0.01,
                damping: 0.1
            });
            
            this.springs.push(spring);
            Matter.World.add(world, spring);

            // Create springs between adjacent particles
            if (i > 0) {
                const prevParticle = this.particles[i - 1];
                const spring = Matter.Constraint.create({
                    bodyA: prevParticle,
                    bodyB: particle,
                    stiffness: 0.01,
                    damping: 0.1
                });
                this.springs.push(spring);
                Matter.World.add(world, spring);
            }
        }

        // Connect first and last particles
        const spring = Matter.Constraint.create({
            bodyA: this.particles[0],
            bodyB: this.particles[this.particles.length - 1],
            stiffness: 0.01,
            damping: 0.1
        });
        this.springs.push(spring);
        Matter.World.add(world, spring);
    }

    display() {
        // Draw springs
        stroke(200, 200, 255, 100);
        strokeWeight(2);
        for (let spring of this.springs) {
            line(
                spring.bodyA.position.x,
                spring.bodyA.position.y,
                spring.bodyB.position.x,
                spring.bodyB.position.y
            );
        }

        // Draw particles
        fill(100, 100, 255, 200);
        noStroke();
        for (let particle of this.particles) {
            circle(particle.position.x, particle.position.y, 20);
        }

        // Draw liquid-like surface
        beginShape();
        fill(100, 100, 255, 150);
        for (let particle of this.particles) {
            vertex(particle.position.x, particle.position.y);
        }
        endShape(CLOSE);
    }

    remove() {
        // Remove all bodies and constraints from the world
        for (let particle of this.particles) {
            Matter.World.remove(world, particle);
        }
        for (let spring of this.springs) {
            Matter.World.remove(world, spring);
        }
        Matter.World.remove(world, this.centerBody);
    }
}

function mousePressed() {
    startPoint = createVector(mouseX, mouseY);
}

function mouseDragged() {
    endPoint = createVector(mouseX, mouseY);
}

function mouseReleased() {
    if (startPoint && endPoint) {
        sliceLine = {
            start: startPoint.copy(),
            end: endPoint.copy()
        };
        
        // Check for circle intersections and divide
        checkAndDivideCircles();
        
        startPoint = null;
        endPoint = null;
        sliceLine = null;
    }
}

function checkAndDivideCircles() {
    for (let i = circles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const circle = circles[i];
        const center = createVector(circle.centerBody.position.x, circle.centerBody.position.y);
        
        // Check if slice line goes through circle
        if (lineIntersectsCircle(sliceLine.start, sliceLine.end, center, circle.radius)) {
            // Remove original circle
            circle.remove();
            circles.splice(i, 1);
            
            // Calculate new circle positions
            const sliceAngle = atan2(sliceLine.end.y - sliceLine.start.y, 
                                   sliceLine.end.x - sliceLine.start.x);
            const perpAngle = sliceAngle + PI/2;
            const offset = circle.radius * 0.6;  // Reduced offset for closer circles
            
            // Create two new circles
            circles.push(new LiquidCircle(
                center.x + cos(perpAngle) * offset,
                center.y + sin(perpAngle) * offset,
                circle.radius * 0.7
            ));
            
            circles.push(new LiquidCircle(
                center.x - cos(perpAngle) * offset,
                center.y - sin(perpAngle) * offset,
                circle.radius * 0.7
            ));
        }
    }
}

function lineIntersectsCircle(lineStart, lineEnd, circleCenter, radius) {
    // Calculate the closest point on the line to the circle center
    const lineDir = p5.Vector.sub(lineEnd, lineStart).normalize();
    const centerToStart = p5.Vector.sub(circleCenter, lineStart);
    const projection = centerToStart.dot(lineDir);
    
    // Find the closest point on the line
    const closestPoint = p5.Vector.add(
        lineStart,
        p5.Vector.mult(lineDir, constrain(projection, 0, p5.Vector.dist(lineStart, lineEnd)))
    );
    
    // Check if the closest point is within the circle's radius
    return p5.Vector.dist(closestPoint, circleCenter) < radius;
}

function draw() {
    background(51);
    Matter.Engine.update(engine);
    
    // Display all circles
    for (let circle of circles) {
        circle.display();
    }
    
    // Draw slice line while dragging
    if (startPoint && endPoint) {
        stroke(255);
        strokeWeight(2);
        line(startPoint.x, startPoint.y, endPoint.x, endPoint.y);
    }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

                                   sliceLine.end.x - sliceLine.start.x);

            { r: 255, g: 50, b: 50 },   // Red
            { r: 50, g: 255, b: 50 },   // Green
            { r: 50, g: 50, b: 255 },   // Blue
            { r: 255, g: 255, b: 50 },  // Yellow
            { r: 255, g: 50, b: 255 },  // Magenta
            { r: 50, g: 255, b: 255 }   // Cyan
        ];
    }

        noStroke();
        for (let i = 0; i < this.colors.length; i++) {

        }

        for (let i = 0; i < this.colors.length; i++) {
            if (mx > this.x && mx < this.x + this.size &&
                my > this.y + i * (this.size + this.gap) &&

            }

        this.colors.push(newColor);

function getCircleIntersection(lineStart, lineEnd, circleCenter, radius) {
    const lineDir = p5.Vector.sub(lineEnd, lineStart).normalize();

    const projection = centerToStart.dot(lineDir);
    
    const closestPoint = p5.Vector.add(
        lineStart,
        p5.Vector.mult(lineDir, constrain(projection, 0, p5.Vector.dist(lineStart, lineEnd)))

                center.y - sin(perpAngle) * offset2,

            });

        }
        draggedColor = null;
    } else if (draggedCircle) {
        draggedCircle = null;
    } else if (startPoint && endPoint) {
        sliceLine = {
            start: startPoint.copy(),
            end: endPoint.copy()
        };
        checkAndDivideCircles();
        startPoint = null;
        endPoint = null;
        sliceLine = null;
    }
}

function getCircleIntersection(lineStart, lineEnd, circleCenter, radius) {
    const lineDir = p5.Vector.sub(lineEnd, lineStart).normalize();
    const centerToStart = p5.Vector.sub(circleCenter, lineStart);
    const projection = centerToStart.dot(lineDir);
    
    const closestPoint = p5.Vector.add(
        lineStart,
        p5.Vector.mult(lineDir, constrain(projection, 0, p5.Vector.dist(lineStart, lineEnd)))
    );
    
    return p5.Vector.dist(closestPoint, circleCenter) < radius ? closestPoint : null;
}

function calculateAreas(center, radius, lineStart, lineEnd) {
    const lineDir = p5.Vector.sub(lineEnd, lineStart).normalize();
    const centerToStart = p5.Vector.sub(center, lineStart);
    const perpDist = abs(centerToStart.cross(lineDir).z);
    
    const theta = 2 * acos(perpDist / radius);
    
    const area1 = (sq(radius) * (theta - sin(theta))) / 2;
    const area2 = PI * sq(radius) - area1;
    
    return { area1, area2 };
}

function checkAndDivideCircles() {
    for (let i = circles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const circle = circles[i];
        const center = createVector(circle.centerBody.position.x, circle.centerBody.position.y);
        
        const intersection = getCircleIntersection(sliceLine.start, sliceLine.end, center, circle.radius);
        if (intersection) {
            const areas = calculateAreas(center, circle.radius, sliceLine.start, sliceLine.end);
            const totalArea = PI * sq(circle.radius);
            const ratio1 = areas.area1 / totalArea;
            const ratio2 = areas.area2 / totalArea;
            
            const radius1 = sqrt(ratio1) * circle.radius;
            const radius2 = sqrt(ratio2) * circle.radius;
            
            circle.remove();
            circles.splice(i, 1);
            
            const sliceAngle = atan2(sliceLine.end.y - sliceLine.start.y, 
                                   sliceLine.end.x - sliceLine.start.x);
            const perpAngle = sliceAngle + PI/2;
            
            const offset1 = radius1 * 0.8;
            const offset2 = radius2 * 0.8;
            
            const newCircle1 = new LiquidCircle(
                center.x + cos(perpAngle) * offset1,
                center.y + sin(perpAngle) * offset1,
                radius1,
                circle.color
            );
            newCircle1.colors = [...circle.colors];
            
            const newCircle2 = new LiquidCircle(
                center.x - cos(perpAngle) * offset2,
                center.y - sin(perpAngle) * offset2,
                radius2,
                circle.color
            );
            newCircle2.colors = [...circle.colors];
            
            const separationSpeed = 2;
            Matter.Body.setVelocity(newCircle1.centerBody, {
                x: cos(perpAngle) * separationSpeed,
                y: sin(perpAngle) * separationSpeed
            });
            
            Matter.Body.setVelocity(newCircle2.centerBody, {
                x: -cos(perpAngle) * separationSpeed,
                y: -sin(perpAngle) * separationSpeed
            });
            
            circles.push(newCircle1);
            circles.push(newCircle2);
        }
    }
}
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.4.0/p5.js"></script>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 100vh;
            background: #000;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script>
        let pyramids = [];
        let centerPyramid;
        let canSpawnNew = true;
        let baseSize = 100;
        let maxPyramids = 50;
        let subdivisionLevel = 3;
        let TIME_SCALE = 1.0;

        class Pyramid {
            constructor(x, y, z, size) {
                const h = size * Math.sqrt(6) / 3;
                const r = size / Math.sqrt(3);
                
                this.vertices = [
                    createVector(0, -h, 0),
                    createVector(-r, h/3, -size/2),
                    createVector(-r, h/3, size/2),
                    createVector(r, h/3, 0)
                ];
                
                this.pos = createVector(x, y, z);
                this.vel = createVector(random(-5, 5), random(-5, 5), random(-5, 5));
                this.acc = createVector(0, 0, 0);
                this.size = size;
                this.rotation = createVector(random(TWO_PI), random(TWO_PI), random(TWO_PI));
                this.angularVel = createVector(random(-0.1, 0.1), random(-0.1, 0.1), random(-0.1, 0.1));
                this.mass = size * size * size;
                this.color = color(random(360), 70, 70);
                
                // Physics parameters
                this.attractionStrength = 108.0;
                this.maxSpeed = 20;
                this.friction = 1;
                this.angularFriction =1;
                this.isLocked = false;
                this.stationaryFrames = 0;
                this.stationaryThreshold = 0;
                // this.repulsionStrength = 50.0;
                this.collisionDamping = 0;
                
                // Subdivision storage
                this.subPyramids = [];
                if (subdivisionLevel > 0) {
                    this.subdivide(subdivisionLevel);
                }
            }

            subdivide(level) {
                if (level === 0) return;
                
                function midpoint(v1, v2) {
                    return p5.Vector.add(v1, v2).mult(0.5);
                }
                
                const vertices = this.vertices.map(v => createVector(v.x, v.y, v.z));
                
                // Calculate midpoints
                const mid01 = midpoint(vertices[0], vertices[1]);
                const mid02 = midpoint(vertices[0], vertices[2]);
                const mid03 = midpoint(vertices[0], vertices[3]);
                const mid12 = midpoint(vertices[1], vertices[2]);
                const mid23 = midpoint(vertices[2], vertices[3]);
                const mid31 = midpoint(vertices[3], vertices[1]);
                
                // Create four smaller pyramids' vertices
                this.subPyramids = [
                    [vertices[0], mid01, mid02, mid03],
                    [mid01, vertices[1], mid12, mid31],
                    [mid02, mid12, vertices[2], mid23],
                    [mid03, mid31, mid23, vertices[3]]
                ];
                
                // Recursively subdivide each set of vertices
                if (level > 1) {
                    let newSubPyramids = [];
                    for (let subVertices of this.subPyramids) {
                        let subVerts = [
                            subVertices[0],
                            subVertices[1],
                            subVertices[2],
                            subVertices[3]
                        ];
                        
                        const smid01 = midpoint(subVerts[0], subVerts[1]);
                        const smid02 = midpoint(subVerts[0], subVerts[2]);
                        const smid03 = midpoint(subVerts[0], subVerts[3]);
                        const smid12 = midpoint(subVerts[1], subVerts[2]);
                        const smid23 = midpoint(subVerts[2], subVerts[3]);
                        const smid31 = midpoint(subVerts[3], subVerts[1]);
                        
                        newSubPyramids.push(
                            [subVerts[0], smid01, smid02, smid03],
                            [smid01, subVerts[1], smid12, smid31],
                            [smid02, smid12, subVerts[2], smid23],
                            [smid03, smid31, smid23, subVerts[3]]
                        );
                    }
                    this.subPyramids = newSubPyramids;
                    this.subdivide(level - 1);
                }
            }

            applyForce(force) {
    if (this.isLocked) return;
    let f = p5.Vector.div(force, this.mass);
    this.acc.add(f);
}

attract(center) {
    if (this.isLocked) return createVector(0, 0, 0);
    
    let force = p5.Vector.sub(center.pos, this.pos);
    let distance = force.mag();
    force.normalize();
    let strength = this.attractionStrength * (distance / 1000);
    force.mult(strength);
    return force;
}

//             attract(center) {
//                 if (this.isLocked) return createVector(0, 0, 0);
                
//                 let force = p5.Vector.sub(this.pos, other.pos);
//                 let distance = force.mag();
//                 let minDist = (this.size + other.size) * 1.2;
                
//                 if (distance < minDist) {
//                     force.normalize();
//                     let strength = this.repulsionStrength * pow(1 - distance/minDist, 2) * 5;
//                     force.mult(strength);
                    
//                     if (other.isLocked) {
//                         force.mult(3.0);
//                         this.vel.add(p5.Vector.mult(force, 0.1));
//                     }
                    
//                     return force;
//                 }
//                 return createVector(0, 0, 0);
//             }
          
          repel(other) {
    if (this.isLocked) return createVector(0, 0, 0);
    
    let force = p5.Vector.sub(this.pos, other.pos);
    let distance = force.mag();
    let minDist =0 ;
    
    if (distance < minDist) {
        force.normalize();
        let strength = this.repulsionStrength * pow(1 - distance/minDist, 2) * 5;
        force.mult(strength);
        
        if (other.isLocked) {
            force.mult(3.0);
            this.vel.add(p5.Vector.mult(force, 0.1));
        }
        
        return force;
    }
    return createVector(0, 0, 0);
}

            update() {
                if (this.isLocked) return;
                
                this.vel.add(p5.Vector.mult(this.acc, TIME_SCALE));
                this.vel.limit(this.maxSpeed * TIME_SCALE);
                
                let prevPos = createVector(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, this.pos.z);
                this.pos.add(p5.Vector.mult(this.vel, TIME_SCALE));
                
                for (let other of pyramids) {
                    if (other.isLocked && other !== this) {
                        let dist = p5.Vector.dist(this.pos, other.pos);
                        let minDist = 0 ;
                        
                        if (dist < minDist) {
                            let normal = p5.Vector.sub(this.pos, other.pos).normalize();
                            let relativeVel = p5.Vector.dot(this.vel, normal);
                            
                            if (relativeVel < 0) {
                                let impulse = -relativeVel * (1 + this.collisionDamping);
                                this.vel.add(p5.Vector.mult(normal, impulse));
                                this.pos = p5.Vector.add(
                                    other.pos,
                                    p5.Vector.mult(normal, minDist)
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                this.vel.mult(pow(this.friction, TIME_SCALE));
                this.angularVel.add(p5.Vector.mult(createVector(random(-0.005, 0.005), random(-0.005, 0.005), random(-0.005, 0.005)), TIME_SCALE));
                this.rotation.add(p5.Vector.mult(this.angularVel, TIME_SCALE));
                this.angularVel.mult(this.angularFriction);
                
                this.acc.mult(0);
                
                if (this.vel.mag() < 0.5 && this.angularVel.mag() < 0.05) {
                    let nearbyCount = 0;
                    for (let other of pyramids) {
                        if (other !== this && other.isLocked) {
                            let dist = p5.Vector.dist(this.pos, other.pos);
                            if (dist < (this.size + other.size) * 1.5) {
                                nearbyCount++;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (nearbyCount >= 2) {
                        this.stationaryFrames++;
                        if (this.stationaryFrames > this.stationaryThreshold) {
                            this.isLocked = true;
                        }
                    } else {
                        this.stationaryFrames = 0;
                    }
                } else {
                    this.stationaryFrames = 0;
                }
            }

            show() {
                push();
                translate(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, this.pos.z);
                rotateX(this.rotation.x);
                rotateY(this.rotation.y);
                rotateZ(this.rotation.z);
                
                if (this.subPyramids.length > 0) {
                    for (let subVertices of this.subPyramids) {
                        beginShape(TRIANGLES);
                        specularMaterial(this.color);
                        
                        vertex(subVertices[1].x, subVertices[1].y, subVertices[1].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[2].x, subVertices[2].y, subVertices[2].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[3].x, subVertices[3].y, subVertices[3].z);
                        
                        vertex(subVertices[0].x, subVertices[0].y, subVertices[0].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[1].x, subVertices[1].y, subVertices[1].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[2].x, subVertices[2].y, subVertices[2].z);
                        
                        vertex(subVertices[0].x, subVertices[0].y, subVertices[0].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[2].x, subVertices[2].y, subVertices[2].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[3].x, subVertices[3].y, subVertices[3].z);
                        
                        vertex(subVertices[0].x, subVertices[0].y, subVertices[0].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[3].x, subVertices[3].y, subVertices[3].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[1].x, subVertices[1].y, subVertices[1].z);
                        endShape();
                    }
                } else {
                    beginShape(TRIANGLES);
                    specularMaterial(this.color);
                    
                    vertex(this.vertices[1].x, this.vertices[1].y, this.vertices[1].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[2].x, this.vertices[2].y, this.vertices[2].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[3].x, this.vertices[3].y, this.vertices[3].z);
                    
                    vertex(this.vertices[0].x, this.vertices[0].y, this.vertices[0].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[1].x, this.vertices[1].y, this.vertices[1].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[2].x, this.vertices[2].y, this.vertices[2].z);
                    
                    vertex(this.vertices[0].x, this.vertices[0].y, this.vertices[0].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[2].x, this.vertices[2].y, this.vertices[2].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[3].x, this.vertices[3].y, this.vertices[3].z);
                    
                    vertex(this.vertices[0].x, this.vertices[0].y, this.vertices[0].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[3].x, this.vertices[3].y, this.vertices[3].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[1].x, this.vertices[1].y, this.vertices[1].z);
                    endShape();
                }
                pop();
            }
        }

        function setup() {
            createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGL);
            colorMode(HSB, 360, 100, 100);
            
            centerPyramid = new Pyramid(0, 0, 0, baseSize);
            centerPyramid.isLocked = true;
            pyramids.push(centerPyramid);
        }

        function draw() {
            background(0);
            
            ambientLight(60);
            pointLight(255, 255, 255, 0, -1000, 500);
            
            orbitControl();
            rotateX(-PI/6);
            
            if (pyramids.every(p => p.isLocked) && pyramids.length < maxPyramids && canSpawnNew) {
                let radius = 1000;
                let theta = random(TWO_PI);
                let phi = random(TWO_PI);
                let x = radius * sin(phi) * cos(theta);
                let y = radius * sin(phi) * sin(theta);
                let z = radius * cos(phi);
                
                let newPyramid = new Pyramid(x, y, z, baseSize);
                newPyramid.vel = createVector(-x/100, -y/100, -z/100);
                pyramids.push(newPyramid);
                canSpawnNew = false;
            }
            
            for (let i = 0; i < pyramids.length; i++) {
                let pyramid = pyramids[i];
                
                if (!pyramid.isLocked) {
                    let force = pyramid.attract(centerPyramid);
                    pyramid.applyForce(force);
                    
                    // for (let j = 0; j < pyramids.length; j++) {
                    //     if (i !== j) {
                    //         let other = pyramids[j];
                    //         let repulsion = pyramid.repel(other);
                    //         pyramid.applyForce(repulsion);
                    //     }
                    // }
                }
                
                pyramid.update();
                pyramid.show();
                
                if (pyramid.isLocked && !canSpawnNew) {
                    canSpawnNew = true;
                }
            }
        }

        function windowResized() {
            resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <style>
/*         body {

</head>
<body>
    <script>
        let centerPyramid;
        let orbitingPyramids = [];
        const PYRAMID_COUNT = 20;
        const BASE_SIZE = 200;
        const ORBIT_RADIUS = 2000;
        const GRAVITATIONAL_CONSTANT = 40;
        const SUBDIVISION_LEVEL = 1;

        class Pyramid {
            constructor(x, y, z, size, isCenter = false, subdivisionLevel = 0) {
                const h = size * Math.sqrt(6) / 3;
                const r = size / Math.sqrt(3);
                
                this.vertices = [
                    createVector(0, -h, 0),
                    createVector(-r, h/3, -size/2),
                    createVector(-r, h/3, size/2),
                    createVector(r, h/3, 0)
                ];
                
                this.pos = createVector(x, y, z);
                this.vel = isCenter ? createVector(0, 0, 0) : this.generateInitialVelocity();
                this.rotation = createVector(random(TWO_PI), random(TWO_PI), random(TWO_PI));
                this.angularVel = createVector(random(-0.02, 0.02), random(-0.02, 0.02), random(-0.02, 0.02));
                
                this.size = size;
                this.color = isCenter 
                    ? color(0, 0, 100)  // White for center 
                    : color(random(360), 70, 70);
                this.isCenter = isCenter;
                
                // Subdivision storage
                this.subPyramids = [];
                if (subdivisionLevel > 0) {
                    this.subdivide(subdivisionLevel);
                }
            }

            subdivide(level) {
                if (level === 0) return;
                
                function midpoint(v1, v2) {
                    return p5.Vector.add(v1, v2).mult(0.5);
                }
                
                const vertices = this.vertices.map(v => createVector(v.x, v.y, v.z));
                
                // Calculate midpoints
                const mid01 = midpoint(vertices[0], vertices[1]);
                const mid02 = midpoint(vertices[0], vertices[2]);
                const mid03 = midpoint(vertices[0], vertices[3]);
                const mid12 = midpoint(vertices[1], vertices[2]);
                const mid23 = midpoint(vertices[2], vertices[3]);
                const mid31 = midpoint(vertices[3], vertices[1]);
                
                // Create four smaller pyramids' vertices
                this.subPyramids = [
                    [vertices[0], mid01, mid02, mid03],
                    [mid01, vertices[1], mid12, mid31],
                    [mid02, mid12, vertices[2], mid23],
                    [mid03, mid31, mid23, vertices[3]]
                ];
                
                // Recursively subdivide each set of vertices
                if (level > 1) {
                    let newSubPyramids = [];
                    for (let subVertices of this.subPyramids) {
                        let subVerts = [
                            subVertices[0],
                            subVertices[1],
                            subVertices[2],
                            subVertices[3]
                        ];
                        
                        const smid01 = midpoint(subVerts[0], subVerts[1]);
                        const smid02 = midpoint(subVerts[0], subVerts[2]);
                        const smid03 = midpoint(subVerts[0], subVerts[3]);
                        const smid12 = midpoint(subVerts[1], subVerts[2]);
                        const smid23 = midpoint(subVerts[2], subVerts[3]);
                        const smid31 = midpoint(subVerts[3], subVerts[1]);
                        
                        newSubPyramids.push(
                            [subVerts[0], smid01, smid02, smid03],
                            [smid01, subVerts[1], smid12, smid31],
                            [smid02, smid12, subVerts[2], smid23],
                            [smid03, smid31, smid23, subVerts[3]]
                        );
                    }
                    this.subPyramids = newSubPyramids;
                }
            }

            generateInitialVelocity() {
                // Create a tangential velocity for orbital motion
                let toCenter = p5.Vector.sub(createVector(0, 0, 0), this.pos);
                let tangent = createVector(-toCenter.y, toCenter.x, 0).normalize();
                
                // Velocity magnitude based on distance from center
                let distance = this.pos.mag();
                let speed = sqrt(GRAVITATIONAL_CONSTANT * 500 / distance) /10;
                
                return tangent.mult(speed);
            }

            applyGravity(center) {
                if (this.isCenter) return;

                // Gravitational attraction
                let toCenter = p5.Vector.sub(center.pos, this.pos);
                let distance = toCenter.mag();
                
                // Gravitational force calculation
                let strength = GRAVITATIONAL_CONSTANT * center.size / (distance * distance);
                toCenter.normalize();
                toCenter.mult(strength);
                
                // Update velocity
                this.vel.add(toCenter);
            }

            update() {
                // Update position
                this.pos.add(this.vel);
                
                // Update rotation
                this.rotation.add(this.angularVel);
            }

            show() {
                push();
                translate(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, this.pos.z);
                rotateX(this.rotation.x);
                rotateY(this.rotation.y);
                rotateZ(this.rotation.z);
                
                // Apply specular material for shiny effect
                specularMaterial(this.color);
                shininess(50);
                
                // Draw subdivided pyramids or base pyramid
                if (this.subPyramids.length > 0) {
                    for (let subVertices of this.subPyramids) {
                        beginShape(TRIANGLES);
                        
                        // Side triangles
                        vertex(subVertices[1].x, subVertices[1].y, subVertices[1].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[2].x, subVertices[2].y, subVertices[2].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[3].x, subVertices[3].y, subVertices[3].z);
                        
                        vertex(subVertices[0].x, subVertices[0].y, subVertices[0].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[1].x, subVertices[1].y, subVertices[1].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[2].x, subVertices[2].y, subVertices[2].z);
                        
                        vertex(subVertices[0].x, subVertices[0].y, subVertices[0].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[2].x, subVertices[2].y, subVertices[2].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[3].x, subVertices[3].y, subVertices[3].z);
                        
                        vertex(subVertices[0].x, subVertices[0].y, subVertices[0].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[3].x, subVertices[3].y, subVertices[3].z);
                        vertex(subVertices[1].x, subVertices[1].y, subVertices[1].z);
                        
                        endShape();
                    }
                } else {
                    // Fallback to basic pyramid if no subdivision
                    beginShape(TRIANGLES);
                    
                    vertex(this.vertices[1].x, this.vertices[1].y, this.vertices[1].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[2].x, this.vertices[2].y, this.vertices[2].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[3].x, this.vertices[3].y, this.vertices[3].z);
                    
                    vertex(this.vertices[0].x, this.vertices[0].y, this.vertices[0].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[1].x, this.vertices[1].y, this.vertices[1].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[2].x, this.vertices[2].y, this.vertices[2].z);
                    
                    vertex(this.vertices[0].x, this.vertices[0].y, this.vertices[0].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[2].x, this.vertices[2].y, this.vertices[2].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[3].x, this.vertices[3].y, this.vertices[3].z);
                    
                    vertex(this.vertices[0].x, this.vertices[0].y, this.vertices[0].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[3].x, this.vertices[3].y, this.vertices[3].z);
                    vertex(this.vertices[1].x, this.vertices[1].y, this.vertices[1].z);
                    
                    endShape();
                }
                pop();
            }
        }

        function setup() {
            createCanvas(1080, 1080, WEBGL);
            colorMode(HSB, 360, 100, 100);
          perspective(PI/3, width/height, 0.1, 10000)
          noStroke()
            
            // Create central pyramid with subdivision
            centerPyramid = new Pyramid(0, 0, 0, BASE_SIZE * 2, true, SUBDIVISION_LEVEL+1);
            
            // Create orbiting pyramids
            for (let i = 0; i < PYRAMID_COUNT; i++) {
                // Generate pyramids in a spherical distribution around the center
                let theta = random(TWO_PI);
                let phi = random(TWO_PI);
                let x = ORBIT_RADIUS * sin(phi) * cos(theta);
                let y = ORBIT_RADIUS * sin(phi) * sin(theta);
                let z = ORBIT_RADIUS * cos(phi);
                
                orbitingPyramids.push(new Pyramid(x, y, z, BASE_SIZE, false, SUBDIVISION_LEVEL));
            }
        }

        function draw() {
            background(0);
            
            // Lighting
            ambientLight(50);
            pointLight(255, 255, 255, 500, 500, 500);
            pointLight(255, 255, 255, 500, 500, 500);
            // Orbit controls
            orbitControl();
            
            // Update and draw central pyramid
            centerPyramid.update();  // Added update to make central pyramid spin
            centerPyramid.show();
            
            // Update and draw orbiting pyramids
            for (let pyramid of orbitingPyramids) {
                pyramid.applyGravity(centerPyramid);
                pyramid.update();
                pyramid.show();
            }
        }

        function windowResized() {
            resizeCanvas(1080, 1080);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
